6e29c0aa4a29b540c7d9.en: A cohesive text flows smoothly from one idea to the next.
6e29c0aa4a29b540c7d9.id: Teks yang padu (cohesive) mengalir lancar dari satu gagasan ke gagasan berikutnya.

cb511656ca96b7dd2882.en: Start each paragraph with a topic sentence that tells the reader what it is about.
cb511656ca96b7dd2882.id: Mulai setiap paragraf dengan kalimat utama (topic sentence) yang memberi tahu pembaca isi paragraf itu.

1adc9bc6d530b9075132.en: Use connectives to show how ideas link.
1adc9bc6d530b9075132.id: Pakai kata penghubung (connective) untuk menunjukkan bagaimana gagasan saling terkait.

76400321f979a521d0a9.en: Use pronouns and synonyms to avoid repeating a noun, but make sure the reader knows who or what they mean.
76400321f979a521d0a9.id: Pakai kata ganti (pronoun) dan sinonim (synonym) supaya noun tidak berulang, tetapi pastikan pembaca tahu siapa atau apa yang dimaksud.

03827873b522272bf6c9.en: Every sentence in a paragraph should be about the same topic.
03827873b522272bf6c9.id: Setiap kalimat dalam satu paragraf harus membahas topik yang sama.

d9b6604bb6d717baaaef.en: On the other hand introduces a contrasting idea.
d9b6604bb6d717baaaef.id: On the other hand mengawali gagasan yang berlawanan.

1425136eb09f3ca8b435.en: He replaces Pak Rudi in the second sentence, so the name is not repeated.
1425136eb09f3ca8b435.id: He menggantikan Pak Rudi di kalimat kedua, jadi nama itu tidak diulang.

7c3a94cc0030c931a0c3.en: A topic sentence introduces the main idea. This one tells the reader that the paragraph is about what orangutans eat.
7c3a94cc0030c931a0c3.id: Kalimat utama (topic sentence) menyampaikan gagasan utama. Kalimat ini memberi tahu pembaca bahwa paragraf itu membahas makanan orang utan.

c9e95a50dc5f50849d53.en: However shows a contrast: many people enjoy it, but some shop owners are unhappy.
c9e95a50dc5f50849d53.id: However menunjukkan hal yang berlawanan: banyak orang menyukainya, tetapi beberapa pemilik toko tidak senang.

ba974a2f758a19be6eea.en: However contrasts, as a result shows an effect, for example gives an example and meanwhile shows the same time. Finally introduces the last point, and in addition adds another one.
ba974a2f758a19be6eea.id: However menunjukkan hal yang berlawanan, as a result menunjukkan akibat, for example memberi contoh, dan meanwhile menunjukkan waktu yang sama. Finally mengawali poin terakhir, dan in addition menambahkan satu poin lagi.

6af2e9866054f6d9d23d.en: The topic sentence comes first, then the time connectives First, Then, After that and About two months later put the steps in order.
6af2e9866054f6d9d23d.id: Kalimat utama (topic sentence) ada di awal, lalu kata penghubung waktu (time connectives) First, Then, After that, dan About two months later mengurutkan langkah-langkahnya.

de2b8a01b1f65e02b940.en: Three days later tells the reader that time has passed, so it is a good way to start a new paragraph.
de2b8a01b1f65e02b940.id: Three days later memberi tahu pembaca bahwa waktu sudah berlalu, jadi ini cara yang baik untuk memulai paragraf baru.

68a44fecc592ff5d337d.en: Her and she could mean either Dewi or Tara. Using a name instead of a pronoun would make the sentence clear.
68a44fecc592ff5d337d.id: Her dan she bisa berarti Dewi atau Tara. Memakai nama, bukan kata ganti (pronoun), akan membuat kalimat itu jelas.

d5c07fe617878c26c63a.en: Despite their importance looks back to paragraph 1, and bees face many dangers introduces paragraph 2.
d5c07fe617878c26c63a.id: Despite their importance merujuk kembali ke paragraf 1, dan bees face many dangers mengawali paragraf 2.

281d6c2d211ae09a2f3b.en: Consequently shows a result, on the other hand shows a contrast and later that evening shows a change in time.
281d6c2d211ae09a2f3b.id: Consequently menunjukkan akibat, on the other hand menunjukkan hal yang berlawanan, dan later that evening menunjukkan perubahan waktu.

da1ff3224f9f07568adb.en: Sentence 3 is about a cousin playing the flute. Every other sentence is about bamboo, so sentence 3 breaks the flow.
da1ff3224f9f07568adb.id: Kalimat 3 bercerita tentang sepupu yang bermain seruling. Semua kalimat lainnya tentang bambu, jadi kalimat 3 memutus alurnya.

fbbd83e2a8b5869310a9.en: Nevertheless means in spite of this, so it signals a contrast. Taking a longer route is a result of the closed bridge, not a contrast.
fbbd83e2a8b5869310a9.id: Nevertheless berarti walaupun begitu, jadi kata ini menandakan hal yang berlawanan. Mengambil jalan yang lebih jauh adalah akibat dari jembatan yang ditutup, bukan hal yang berlawanan.

c8b90bfae71704acbf8b.en: Therefore shows a result of being hungry. However shows a contrast between liking cheese and disliking tomato.
c8b90bfae71704acbf8b.id: Therefore menunjukkan akibat dari rasa lapar. However menunjukkan perbedaan antara suka keju dan tidak suka tomat.

b7e3e21812decdcea9ed.en: A concluding sentence ties the ideas together. This one returns to the topic of recycling and the purpose of the paragraph.
b7e3e21812decdcea9ed.id: Kalimat penutup (concluding sentence) menyatukan gagasan-gagasan itu. Kalimat ini kembali ke topik daur ulang (recycling) dan tujuan paragraf itu.

6ff90905c350512f4029.en: The topic sentence comes first. At first, Next and Every morning put the steps in order, and As a result gives the final effect.
6ff90905c350512f4029.id: Kalimat utama (topic sentence) ada di awal. At first, Next, dan Every morning mengurutkan langkah-langkahnya, dan As a result menunjukkan akibat akhirnya.

ba667f5de97a8f6cab26.en: Each connective has a clear job: adding, contrasting, summing up, showing sequence, showing similarity or showing a condition.
ba667f5de97a8f6cab26.id: Setiap kata penghubung (connective) punya tugas yang jelas: menambahkan, menunjukkan hal yang berlawanan, menyimpulkan, menunjukkan urutan, menunjukkan kesamaan, atau menunjukkan syarat.

4094d0b339e2095e886d.en: In addition and moreover add. On the other hand and despite this contrast. Consequently and because of this show a result. Afterwards and meanwhile show time.
4094d0b339e2095e886d.id: In addition dan moreover menambahkan. On the other hand dan despite this menunjukkan hal yang berlawanan. Consequently dan because of this menunjukkan akibat. Afterwards dan meanwhile menunjukkan waktu.

15cc20958a32670e5248.en: He could refer to Rangga or to Kofi. Fix it by naming the person: Rangga told Kofi that Kofi had won the prize.
15cc20958a32670e5248.id: He bisa berarti Rangga atau Kofi. Perbaiki dengan menyebut nama orangnya: Rangga told Kofi that Kofi had won the prize.

8ff6c81319c9b83a4376.en: Fortunately signals a change from problems to answers. It makes a smooth link between the paragraphs.
8ff6c81319c9b83a4376.id: Fortunately menandakan perubahan dari masalah ke jawaban. Kata ini menyambungkan kedua paragraf dengan mulus.

53e2ef51068b0de7b591.en: Expensive petrol is the cause and more bicycles is the effect, so you need a connective that shows a result.
53e2ef51068b0de7b591.id: Bensin yang mahal adalah sebab dan makin banyak sepeda adalah akibat, jadi kamu perlu kata penghubung (connective) yang menunjukkan akibat.

8ca402b2a3aeb9de2ab9.en: Meanwhile shows two events happening together. The comma comes after it, and the rest forms a normal sentence.
8ca402b2a3aeb9de2ab9.id: Meanwhile menunjukkan dua kejadian yang terjadi bersamaan. Koma (comma) diletakkan setelah kata itu, dan sisanya membentuk kalimat biasa.

3456bcde93954670032a.en: The topic sentence comes first, then its describes the tower. However gives a contrast, Consequently shows the effect, and the last sentence adds a final detail.
3456bcde93954670032a.id: Kalimat utama (topic sentence) ada di awal, lalu kalimat dengan its menggambarkan menara itu. However menunjukkan hal yang berlawanan, Consequently menunjukkan akibat, dan kalimat terakhir menambahkan rincian penutup.

3145dd068924d2380d30.en: The first sentence introduces the idea, the second gives a fact, the third explains why it matters, and the last concludes.
3145dd068924d2380d30.id: Kalimat pertama menyampaikan gagasan, kalimat kedua memberi fakta, kalimat ketiga menjelaskan mengapa hal itu penting, dan kalimat terakhir menyimpulkan.

18d46296493d4a5422ff.en: First and Afterwards show the order of events. Also links the two shopping sentences. The other edits do not help the flow.
18d46296493d4a5422ff.id: First dan Afterwards menunjukkan urutan kejadian. Also menghubungkan dua kalimat tentang belanja. Perubahan lainnya tidak membantu alur tulisan.

2dacfd9ab52458582aa2.en: B introduces the cause, D shows what happened, A is the result and C is the conclusion.
2dacfd9ab52458582aa2.id: B menyebutkan penyebabnya, D menunjukkan apa yang terjadi, A adalah akibatnya, dan C adalah kesimpulannya.

8ec6ab36b3e49950d53d.en: The first link is a contrast (free but crowded), so However. The second link is a result (because it is crowded, we go on weekdays), so Therefore.
8ec6ab36b3e49950d53d.id: Sambungan pertama menunjukkan hal yang berlawanan (gratis tetapi ramai), jadi However. Sambungan kedua menunjukkan akibat (karena ramai, kami pergi pada hari biasa), jadi Therefore.

918b1fdf6a2886720578.en: It usually comes first and the rest of the paragraph supports it.
918b1fdf6a2886720578.id: Kalimat itu biasanya ada di awal dan bagian lain dari paragraf mendukungnya.

c3923d520008d078a2c3.en: A paragraph groups sentences about one idea, so a new paragraph begins with a new idea.
c3923d520008d078a2c3.id: Paragraf mengumpulkan kalimat-kalimat tentang satu gagasan, jadi paragraf baru dimulai dengan gagasan baru.

646a7f24e72d846a13ce.en: However shows contrast and therefore shows a result.
646a7f24e72d846a13ce.id: However menunjukkan hal yang berlawanan dan therefore menunjukkan akibat.

4e5a1a9171a6215188bc.en: A pronoun refers to a noun already named, which helps the text flow.
4e5a1a9171a6215188bc.id: Kata ganti (pronoun) merujuk pada kata benda (noun) yang sudah disebut, dan ini membuat teks mengalir lancar.

db906624ff0db0c78663.en: Firstly and secondly show order. Contrast is shown by words such as however.
db906624ff0db0c78663.id: Firstly dan secondly menunjukkan urutan. Hal yang berlawanan ditunjukkan oleh kata seperti however.

0806ced42744683bb7d7.en: Paragraphs help the reader follow changes in a text.
0806ced42744683bb7d7.id: Paragraf membantu pembaca mengikuti perubahan dalam teks.
